headlines.headline: Klay Thompson signs with Heat after Mavericks buyout, joining Giannis and Bam
headlines.detail: Miami finalized a two-year, roughly $11.5 million deal with four-time champion Klay Thompson after he cleared waivers, giving the Heat a second Hall of Fame-caliber addition alongside Giannis Antetokounmpo. Thompson landed on Miami's radar once LeBron James signed instead with Philadelphia.

headlines.headline: Browns name Deshaun Watson Week 1 starter over Shedeur Sanders
headlines.detail: Cleveland handed Watson the Week 1 job two days after he was booed by home fans in preseason, setting up his first regular-season start since tearing his Achilles in 2024. Elsewhere, the Texans traded for WR Kayshon Boutte from New England.

headlines.headline: NCAA Oversight Committee advances transfer-window and offseason practice overhaul
headlines.detail: A proposal to add OTA-style spring practices, two windows totaling 21 practices, heads toward a final August vote, effective Jan. 1, 2027 if approved. Comes as 2026 is the first cycle without a spring transfer portal window.

headlines.headline: Kentucky judge grants eligibility to Castellanos, Mitchell as portal fallout continues
headlines.detail: A TRO makes both players eligible for 2026-27 and free to enter the portal. Mitchell has committed to Kentucky, joining eligibility-case transfers Donovan Dent (LSU), Treysen Eaglestaff (UC San Diego) and Dallin Hall (Utah State).
